2609.32672.title: STAMP: Predicting Out-of-Distribution Generalization without Target Data
2609.32672.paper_summary: Predicting whether a trained model will generalize under distribution shift remains difficult, especially when target-domain data are unavailable. We introduce STAMP (Semantic Temporal Augmented Model Prediction), a source-only, target-label-free criterion that estimates out-of-distribution (OOD) performance from paired source-domain images. STAMP computes the output-space correlation ratio $η^2=S_B/S_T$ by contrasting semantically stable pairs with random pairs: higher $η^2$ indicates that model outputs vary with semantic identity rather than nuisance variation. On 44 chest X-ray models spanning CNNs, ViTs, MetaFormers, foundation models, and SSL/VLM probes, temporal STAMP attains Spearman correlations of $0.844$--$0.855$ with macro AUROC on VinDr-CXR, CheXpert, and MIMIC-CXR; a class-matched variant improves single-class RSNA from $0.311$ to $0.663$. STAMP attains the best average source-only medical ranking and outperforms the target-domain ATC and AoTL estimators without any target data. On 27 ImageNet models, temperature-scaled STAMPTS attains $ρ{=}0.984$ on ObjectNet and $ρ\geq0.905$ on four additional distribution shifts, with partial correlations of $0.662$--$0.949$ after controlling for ImageNet accuracy. Requiring approximately 12s per model on one GPU, STAMP is a practical pre-deployment model-selection and auditing tool.
2609.32672.paper_summary_zh: 預測訓練模型在分佈變化下是否能夠泛化仍然很困難，特別是當目標領域數據不可用時。<lb/>我們介紹了STAMP（語義時間增強模型預測），這是一種僅基於來源且不需要目標標籤的標準，旨在從配對的來源領域圖像中估計分佈外（OOD）性能。<lb/>STAMP通過將語義穩定的配對與隨機配對進行對比，計算輸出空間的相關比率$η^2=S_B/S_T$：較高的$η^2$表明模型輸出隨著語義身份而變化，而不是隨著干擾變化而變化。<lb/>在涵蓋CNN、ViTs、MetaFormers、基礎模型和SSL/VLM探針的44個胸部X光模型上，時間STAMP在VinDr-CXR、CheXpert和MIMIC-CXR上的宏觀AUROC達到了$0.844$--$0.855$的斯皮爾曼相關性；一個類別匹配的變體將單類RSNA從$0.311$提高到$0.663$。<lb/>STAMP在僅基於來源的醫療排名中達到了最佳平均值，並且在沒有任何目標數據的情況下超越了目標領域的ATC和AoTL估計器。<lb/>在27個ImageNet模型上，經過溫度縮放的STAMPTS在ObjectNet上達到了$ρ{=}0.984$，並在四個額外的分佈變化上達到了$ρ\geq0.905$，在控制ImageNet準確性後的部分相關性為$0.662$--$0.949$。<lb/>每個模型在一個GPU上大約需要12秒，STAMP是一個實用的預部署模型選擇和審核工具。
